 Learn more US stocks rose on Wednesday as SpaceX's ( SPCX ) quarterly results  renewed enthusiasm for the AI tech trade. 
 The Dow Jones Industrial Average ( ^DJI ) rose 0.7%, while the S&P 500 ( ^GSPC ) gained almost 0.6%. The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite ( ^IXIC ) climbed 1% after the major averages closed mixed on Monday. 
 ( ^DJI )
 Go deeper with AlphaSpace 52,215.16 -652.82 (-1.23%) At close: October 23 at 4:42:55 PM EDT ^DJI ^GSPC ^IXIC Shares of SpaceX surged nearly 8% after posting quarterly results, while Elon Musk, who also leads Tesla, said both companies formed special committees to discuss a potential merger . 
 Tesla, along with social media giant Meta, is expected to report results after the bell on Wednesday, kicking off Big Tech's earnings season. 
 Meanwhile, Anthropic ( ANTH.PVT ) could file its S-1 as soon as Friday , paving the way for what could be the largest IPO in history, according to people familiar with the AI developer's plans. 
 Outside of the tech world, Netflix ( NFLX ) shares dropped 5% after the streamer's Q4 revenue forecast missed estimates and 2026 ad revenue guidance was lowered. 
 Brent crude futures ( BZ=F ) climbed to $110 per barrel after a Saudi Arabian oil field was attacked amid ongoing Middle East tensions. Meanwhile, West Texas Intermediate crude ( CL=F ) traded near $98 per barrel. 
 LIVE COVERAGE IS OVER 17 updates Wed, October 21, 2026 at 8:01 PM UTC Ines Ferré Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq rally as SpaceX surges, Meta and Tesla earnings on deck
 US stocks rallied on Wednesday as SpaceX's ( SPCX )  quarterly results  boosted optimism about AI and a potential merger with Tesla ( TSLA ). 
 The EV maker was on deck to report after the closing bell. Social media giant Meta ( META ) will also release quarterly results as Big Tech's earnings kick off. 
 ( META )
 Go deeper with AlphaSpace 642.62 -6.23 (-0.96%) At close: October 23 at 4:00:01 PM EDT 640.10 -2.52 (-0.39%) After hours: October 23 at 7:59:38 PM EDT META TSLA SPCX The Dow Jones Industrial Average ( ^DJI ) gained 0.7%, while the S&P 500 ( ^GSPC ) rallied 0.5%. The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite ( ^IXIC ) jumped 1%, led by chipmaker stocks. 
 Wed, October 21, 2026 at 7:37 PM UTC Jared Blikre Cybersecurity stocks surge on a critical web flaw
 A critical bug in the code behind 70% of the world's websites sent security stocks higher. The group was already climbing before the fix arrived. 
 Zscaler ( ZS ), Okta ( OKTA ), Cloudflare ( NET ) and CrowdStrike ( CRWD ) are up 5% to 7%, roughly three to five times their typical daily moves over the past month, according to Yahoo Finance calculations. Okta, Cloudflare and CrowdStrike are each on track for their biggest gain since September. 
 SentinelOne ( S ) and Tenable ( TENB ) are up 3% to 4%. The cybersecurity ETFs HACK and CIBR are each up about 2%, ahead of the broader software ETF IGV. 
 PHP released emergency patches Wednesday for two critical flaws, dubbed PHP2Shell, that could let attackers take over any server running PHP 5.4 or later. Details leaked a day early, and Cloudflare logged attacks before the fix went out. 
 The rally had a head start. 
 The flaw's details had been circulating since Tuesday, and CrowdStrike, Zscaler and Okta were named partners on Nvidia's ( NVDA ) new AI-agent security platform Wednesday morning. 
 Not everyone joined in. Palo Alto Networks ( PANW ) and Fortinet ( FTNT ) are up only 1% to 2%, and Varonis ( VRNS ) is flat. 
 Watch whether the gains hold Thursday, once the patch is widely in place. 
 Wed, October 21, 2026 at 7:27 PM UTC Jared Blikre Netflix has been cut in half
 Wall Street spent a year paying up for Netflix's growth. It's now paying less than half as much for the same company. 
 Netflix ( NFLX ) is down about 4% after its fourth quarter revenue forecast came in light, a move more than three times its typical daily swing over the past month, by Yahoo Finance calculations. 
 The stock is on track for its lowest close since August 2024 and sits about 51% below its June 2025 record close. 
 The business is hardly falling apart. Netflix still expects double-digit revenue growth next quarter, just not as much as Wall Street wanted. Analysts trimmed their price targets anyway, as my colleague Ines Ferre reported . 
 On the chart, $60 is the next stop down. That's where the stock bottomed in August 2024. 
 The setup for bulls is a close back above $67 in the next few days, which would turn Wednesday's breakdown into a potential bear trap , a drop that reverses and catches late sellers off guard. 
 Watch whether Netflix punches back above $67 this week on a closing basis or keeps drifting toward $60. 
 Wed, October 21, 2026 at 7:22 PM UTC Jared Blikre Oil jumps after an attack on a Saudi oil field
 Saudi Arabia's state news agency reported this afternoon that an Aramco oil field in the country's Eastern Region came under attack. Details on any damage, or on whether production was affected, weren't immediately available. 
 Brent crude futures ( BZ=F ) jumped more than $1.50 a barrel within minutes of the headline and are on track for their highest close since May 19, according to Yahoo Finance calculations. 
 Stocks barely flinched. The S&P 500 ( ^GSPC ) stayed higher, energy stocks ( XLE ) are up modestly, and even United Airlines ( UAL ), one of the companies most exposed to fuel costs, is holding most of its gain from this morning. 
 The next test is $110. A weekly close above that level would put roughly $120 to $122 in play, according to a BofA Global Research report. 
 Wed, October 21, 2026 at 7:15 PM UTC Ines Ferré AT&T sinks 6% as CEO downplays SpaceX's StarLink threat
 AT&T ( T ) shares fell 6% Wednesday as investors weighed the wireless carrier's third-quarter earnings against growing competitive concerns surrounding SpaceX's Starlink Mobile ambitions. 
 On Thursday, SpaceX ( SPCX ) COO Gwynne Shotwell said the company plans to use its expanding wireless spectrum portfolio and satellites to "become a major mobile carrier" in the US. 
 Asked about Starlink's threat on AT&T's Q3 earnings call, CEO John Stankey pointed to the telecom giant's extensive terrestrial infrastructure and the density required to handle everyday mobile traffic. 
 "It is not something that gets done overnight. I would not over-rotate on what I would call one carrier of low-band spectrum," said Stankey. 
 He argued that AT&T's established network has a structural advantage because most mobile traffic occurs where the company already has coverage, including indoors. 
 "98% of the traffic is where we have already built and where we already have capabilities," he said, 
 AT&T added 379,000 postpaid phone customers net of disconnects in the third quarter, below the Bloomberg consensus estimate of 387,410. 
 Wed, October 21, 2026 at 6:40 PM UTC Jennifer Schonberger, David Hollerith Stablecoins just got some regulatory clarity
 A federal banking regulator on Wednesday released a final version of new rules on dollar-pegged stablecoins. 
 The rules give companies issuing stablecoins more flexibility while leaving a contentious question of stablecoin yield unresolved. 
 Circle Internet Group ( CRCL ), the country's largest stablecoin issuer, and major crypto exchange Coinbase Global ( COIN ) applauded the new rules. (Disclosure: Yahoo Finance has a partnership with Coinbase.) 
 Circle ( CRCL ) and Coinbase ( COIN ) stock each rose more than 4%. Other crypto stocks and companies that offer customers stablecoins, including Robinhood Markets ( HOOD ), Gemini Space Station ( GEMI ), Bullish ( BLSH ), and PayPal ( PYPL ), also rose. 
 TD Cowen policy analyst Jaret Seiberg described the decision as a "negative for banks as it does not fully shut down the ability for platforms to pay yield on stablecoins." 
 "We see this as creating uncertainty," Seiberg wrote to clients on Wednesday. "It also suggests the Supreme Court ultimately will need to decide what yield payments are legal."

 Wed, October 21, 2026 at 6:11 PM UTC Tesla is trading more like SpaceX than a car company
 Yahoo Finance's Jared Blikre reports: 
 Tesla still sells cars. Its stock has stopped trading like it. 
 Over the past 20 sessions, the daily moves of Tesla ( TSLA ) have had a correlation of 0.64 with SpaceX ( SPCX ), according to Yahoo Finance calculations. Correlation measures how consistently two stocks move in the same direction, where 1 means they always move in lockstep. In SpaceX's first 20 sessions after its June IPO, the reading was just 0.15. 
 The two stocks finished in the same direction on 15 of the last 20 days.

 Wed, October 21, 2026 at 5:06 PM UTC Ines Ferré Supermicro stock jumps as server maker lifts revenue forecast
 Super Micro Computer ( SMCI ) stock jumped as much as 12% on Wednesday, while peers Dell Technologies ( DELL ) and Hewlett Packard Enterprise ( HPE ) gained 5% and 4%, respectively. 
 The AI server maker raised its fiscal first quarter revenue forecast by $4 billion, signaling stronger-than-expected demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure. 
 Supermicro now expects revenue of $18.5 billion to $19.5 billion for the quarter ended Sept. 30, up from its previous forecast of $14.5 billion to $15.5 billion. 
 The company also raised its gross margin forecast to 12% to 12.5%, compared with its previous outlook of 10.4% to 10.8%, citing a more favorable customer and product mix. 
 Supermicro will present its complete Q1 fiscal year 2027 financial results on Nov. 3. 
 Read more here. 
 Wed, October 21, 2026 at 4:00 PM UTC Ines Ferré Nasdaq 100 outperforms as SpaceX stock surges
 The Nasdaq 100 ( ^NDX ) gained more than 1.2% on Wednesday, outperforming the major averages, as SpaceX ( SPCX ) stock surged following the company's AI-fueled quarterly results. 
 Chip stocks Nvidia ( NVDA ) rose more than 1.5%, while AMD ( AMD ) also rose 2%, sparked by exploding growth in SpaceX's AI compute business. 
 The S&P 500 ( ^GSPC ) rose 0.5% while the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite ( ^IXIC ) climbed 1.1%. Meanwhile, the Dow Jones Industrial Average ( ^DJI ) edged higher. 
 Wed, October 21, 2026 at 3:15 PM UTC Ines Ferré Netflix stock poised to open lower as revenue forecast and ad revenue guidance disappoint
 Netflix ( NFLX ) stock was poised to open 5% lower on Wednesday as the streaming giant's Q4 revenue outlook came in below Wall Street estimates, signaling slower growth. 
 Fourth-quarter outlook for the company's top line came in at $13.44 billion, short of the consensus analyst estimate of $13.51 billion. 
 Netflix also cut its 2026 ad revenue guidance from $3 billion to $2.7 billion due to a slower-than-expected rollout of certain ad product capabilities. 
 Wall Street has been laser-focused on engagement , which management argued was healthy given the response to this year's price increases. 
 When it comes to the US, "our engagement is solid, and it will allow us to continue to grow as we have for the last several years," Greg Peters, co-CEO of Netflix, said during the earnings call. 
 Read more here. 
 Wed, October 21, 2026 at 2:30 PM UTC Jared Blikre Berkshire Hathaway hits its first record high since Buffett’s CEO exit announcement
 It took Berkshire Hathaway 17 months to get back to where it was the day before Warren Buffett said he'd hand over the keys. The S&P 500 gained more than 35% in that time. 
 Berkshire's Class B stock ( BRK-B ) closed at a record Tuesday, topping its May 2, 2025, high by two cents. It and the Class A stock ( BRK-A ) hit intraday records this morning. 
 Berkshire is on pace to rise in 14 of its last 15 sessions, including a 10-day winning streak — its first since 2018, according to Yahoo Finance calculations. 
 The run began as investors rotated out of AI winners. Since the S&P 500's Oct. 6 record, Berkshire is up about 7% while the index has slipped. 
 Greg Abel, CEO since January, has started putting Buffett's cash to work. Berkshire bought back about $4.5 billion of its stock in the second quarter and ended 14 straight quarters of net stock selling. Buffett said Sept. 18 he'd also step down as chairman. The stock bottomed two weeks later. 
 Watch whether Berkshire holds $540 heading into third quarter results in early November. Holding it would turn the old ceiling into a floor. Slipping back below would make the breakout look like a bull trap — a breakout that quickly reverses. 
 Wed, October 21, 2026 at 2:10 PM UTC Ines Ferré Anthropic to publicly file for IPO as early as Friday, sources say
 Yahoo Finance's Dan Howley and David Hollerith report: 
 Anthropic is set to publicly file its S-1 investor prospectus as soon as Friday, according to three people familiar with the artificial intelligence firm's plans. The move would mark a crucial next step for what could be the biggest IPO in history. 
 The much-anticipated public debut , which is expected to surpass SpaceX's June IPO, is widely viewed as a crucial test of investor appetite for the artificial intelligence boom, as investors have grown more concerned about the industry's massive spending. 
 Anthropic confidentially submitted a draft IPO registration statement to the Securities and Exchange Commission in June. Under SEC rules, companies using the confidential process must make their registration materials available 15 calendar days before the start of their formal investor roadshow. 
 Anthropic did not respond to a request for comment on the timing of its S-1. 
 Read more here. 
 Wed, October 21, 2026 at 1:36 PM UTC US stocks edge higher as earnings roll in
 US stocks opened higher as strong results from SpaceX ( SPCX ) reignited enthusiasm for AI-related companies ahead of highly anticipated earnings from Meta and Tesla. 
 The S&P 500 ( ^GSPC ) rose slightly while the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite ( ^IXIC ) climbed 0.5%. Meanwhile, the Dow Jones Industrial Average ( ^DJI ) was little changed after the major averages closed mixed on Monday. 
 ( ^DJI )
 Go deeper with AlphaSpace 52,215.16 -652.82 (-1.23%) At close: October 23 at 4:42:55 PM EDT ^DJI ^GSPC ^IXIC SpaceX ( SPCX ) shares jumped after the Elon Musk-led company reported better-than-expected quarterly results fueled by growth in AI infrastructure and cloud services. Musk also said SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees to discuss a potential merger. 
 Investors now turn to results from Tesla ( TSLA ) and Meta ( META ) after the bell, kicking off the wave of tech giants reporting earnings over the coming days. 
 Wed, October 21, 2026 at 1:04 PM UTC Jared Blikre SpaceX leads a space-stock rally after its earnings beat
 October has been brutal for space's newcomers, with a typical name down about 26%. SpaceX's blowout quarter is giving them a breather. 
 SpaceX ( SPCX ) is jumping in premarket trading after third quarter revenue and profit topped Wall Street's estimates. My colleague Pras Subramanian has the full breakdown , and the company's AI business now brings in nearly half its sales . 
 ( SPCX )
 Go deeper with AlphaSpace 147.49 +2.74 (+1.89%) At close: October 23 at 4:00:00 PM EDT 147.58 +0.09 (+0.06%) After hours: October 23 at 7:59:59 PM EDT Every stock in a Yahoo Finance basket of newer space names is higher before the bell. Firefly Aerospace ( FLY ) and Satellogic ( SATL ) are among the leaders, while Rocket Lab ( RKLB ) and AST SpaceMobile ( ASTS ) trail. 
 Large figures show Tuesday's moves. Smaller figures show Wednesday pre-market moves. · Yahoo Finance The old guard isn't joining in. Lockheed Martin ( LMT ) and Northrop Grumman ( NOC ), both up this month, are barely moving. 
 One morning doesn't undo a month. 
 Watch whether SpaceX can hold $150 throughout the day, and whether its followers keep their gains. Above that, the next potential wall is $172, which capped the stock in July and October. 
 Also, up to 1.3 billion shares unlock Thursday , the biggest release yet, though past unlocks have barely dented the stock. 
 Wed, October 21, 2026 at 12:15 PM UTC Ines Ferré Musk backs SpaceX-Tesla merger idea as both boards form special committees
 Yahoo Finance's Pras Subramanian reports: 
 Elon Musk said on SpaceX's ( SPCX ) third quarter earnings call late Tuesday that he thinks merging the company with Tesla ( TSLA ) would be a good idea and revealed that both companies have formed special committees to study a deal. 
 Answering an analyst question on the call, the SpaceX and Tesla CEO took on the 800-pound gorilla in the room — a merger of his biggest companies. 
 "This is definitely kind of a question where I feel like I'm tap dancing through a minefield," Musk joked, before adding some new information.

 Wed, October 21, 2026 at 11:09 AM UTC Ines Ferré Elon Musk's SpaceX is now mostly an AI company
 Yahoo Finance's Jared Blikre reports: 
 Investors bought SpaceX for the rockets. They're getting an AI cloud. 
 The company's AI segment, freshly renamed "Super Intelligence," brought in $7.6 billion in the third quarter, SpaceX ( SPCX ) reported Tuesday. That's more than Starlink and the rocket business combined, and more than half of SpaceX's $14.6 billion in total revenue. 
 A year ago, AI made up about 15% of sales. In SpaceX's first report as a public company , it was a third. One quarter later, Starlink lost its top spot. 
 Read more here. 
 Wed, October 21, 2026 at 10:00 AM UTC Ines Ferré SpaceX shares on pace to open higher after better than expected results
 Yahoo Finance's Pras Subramanian reports: 
 SpaceX ( SPCX ) reported highly anticipated third quarter results on Tuesday after the bell Here are the top-level highlights: 
 SpaceX stock was up 6% after the release. SpaceX said it added $6.7 billion of "incremental SI solutions and infrastructure revenue year-over-year, driven by cloud services agreements, the acquisition of Cursor, and our growing SI models and software applications, including Grok Bot."
